clean_repro.probe: REST POST /v2/vectordb/entities/upsert with JSON field containing bare string (meta=\"plain_string\") followed by pymilvus MilvusClient.get() read attempt
clean_repro.observed: REST upsert succeeded (HTTP 200, upsertCount=1, upsertIds=[999]), but pymilvus gRPC get failed with MilvusException: (code=1, message=Unexpected error, message=<Expected object or value>). REST API accepted bare string \"bare_string_test\" as valid JSON field value, but gRPC client cannot read it due to JSON parsing failure.
clean_repro.evidence_cmd: curl -X POST 'http://localhost:19530/v2/vectordb/entities/upsert' -d '{"collectionName": "test_json", "data": [{"id": 999, "vector": [0.1, 0.2, 0.3, 0.4], "meta": "bare_string_test"}]}' && python -c 'from pymilvus import MilvusClient; client = MilvusClient("http://localhost:19530"); client.get(collection_name="test_json", ids=[999], output_fields=["meta"])'

verified_assumptions: REST /v2/vectordb endpoints should accept the same data formats as gRPC APIs
JSON fields should contain valid JSON objects/arrays, not bare strings
Data written via REST should be readable via gRPC clients (cross-protocol compatibility)

contract_refs: constraint_id: milvus_type_json_001 - dataType == JSON (JSON scalar data type)
constraint_id: milvus_behavioral_insert_then_get_001 - Insert entities should be retrievable via Get
constraint_id: milvus_contract_data_visibility_001 - Insert-then-Get visibility across protocols

source_grounding.call_chain_traced: REST /v2/vectordb/entities/upsert → checkAndSetData() → field.DataType_JSON case → []byte(dataString) → no JSON validation → stores invalid bare string → gRPC read fails with JSON parse error
source_grounding.note: 源码接地发现:REST v2 API 的 checkAndSetData 函数在处理 DataType_JSON 字段时(line 760-761),直接将 dataString(可能是 bare string 如 \"plain_string\")转换为 []byte 存储不做任何 JSON 格式验证。而其他数据类型(如 Array, Bool, Int64 等)都有相应的 json.Unmarshal 校验。这导致 REST 接受非法 JSON 值但 gRPC 客户端读取时 JSON parser 抛出 \"Expected object or value\" 错误。

falsification.probe: Valid JSON object test: upsert with meta={\"valid\": \"json_object\"} then pymilvus get
falsification.observed: Valid JSON object upsert succeeded AND pymilvus read succeeded (returned data correctly). This confirms the issue is specifically with bare strings being accepted when they shouldn't be, not a general gRPC read problem.

verdicts.rationale: 真缺陷确认:REST v2 /v2/vectordb/entities/upsert 接受 JSON 字段的 bare string 值(如 meta=\"plain_string\"),存储成功(HTTP 200, upsertCount=1);但 pymilvus gRPC MilvusClient.get() 读该数据时报错 \"Unexpected error: Expected object or value\"。源码显示 checkAndSetData 函数对 DataType_JSON 字段直接 []byte(dataString) 不做 JSON 格式校验,而其他类型都有 json.Unmarshal 验证。这造成 REST 写入非法 JSON 但 gRPC 无法读取的跨协议不一致。符合 blindspot_indicators 中 \"REST v2 API data type serialization\"模式。
